_comment: FIVE registrations, not four hooks. gotcha-guard.mjs is registered TWICE, against
different matchers (Edit|Write and Bash), because it guards two different hazard
classes. A verification phrased as 'all four hooks fire' counts it once and would
pass green while the Bash matcher silently stopped firing — the same shape as the
doc-authority defect this plugin exists to have fixed. Count registrations.
THE SERVED PLUGIN IS A COPY, NOT A LINK — found 2026-08-28, and it is the reason
this file's version matters. Claude Code copies the marketplace into
~/.claude/plugins/cache/<mkt>/<plugin>/<version>/ at install time and serves THAT.
Editing propagate/hooks/*.mjs changes nothing until `claude plugin update
propagate@tathya` runs AND the session restarts. Measured that day: the running
gotcha-guard.mjs was the 2026-08-22 snapshot while source had moved on 08-24, and
both manifests said 0.2.0 — so nothing could ever have invalidated the copy. Bump
the version in .claude-plugin/plugin.json with any hook change, or the change is
authored and not delivered.
${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} is resolved by Claude Code to this plugin's root, so these
paths survive the plugin being installed anywhere. The previous arrangement
hardcoded $HOME/.claude/hooks and $HOME/.claude/skills/propagate.
rule-guard, added 2026-08-28. The matcher is Agent|Task|ExitPlanMode and NOT
Bash|Edit|Write, because today exactly one rule declares a trigger and it is
about subagent dispatch. Widen this the moment a rule declares a trigger for
another tool — a matcher narrower than the rule set is a rule that loads and
can never fire.
Verified live 2026-08-28 that PreToolUse DOES fire on Agent and that an omitted
`model` is visible as an absent key, using a Bash control in the same config so
'does not fire' was distinguishable from 'config never reloaded'.
